company.name: Auctomatic
company.shortDescription: Auctomatic offers an auction and marketplace management system for individual sellers on the website.
company.description:
Auctomatic, a [Y Combinator](http://crunchbase.com/organization/y-combinator) company, offers an auction and marketplace management system for all of those individual sellers on such sites as [Ebay](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/ebay), [Amazon](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/amazon), Overstock and others. The application lets you list your items as well as manage your sales, but it also helps you understand how to best optimize your selling and maximize profits.

The company also received an investment from [Paul Buchheit](http://www.crunchbase.com/person/paul-buchheit), the lead developer of Gmail.

productsAndServices.description: A software platform that helps individual sellers manage their auctions and marketplace listings online.
